question: Can broad market trend remove the long-only relative leaders' severe bear-market loss?
motivation: After seeing the 89.33% drawdown from November 2021 to September 2022 on the ten-major relative leader portfolio, test conditioning that existing position on a bullish BTC/USD cloud. This is explicitly an after-result hypothesis.
single_variable: Original highest scored available USD-bullish coin, frozen leader tie and exact hourly position ledger. Hold that same target only on 12H decisions with positive and ready 20/50 BTC/USD EMA spread. Compare the complementary bearish BTC state and the same BTC cloud lagged by a fixed 30 days. Common warmup with 30-day lag available for all gated arms; original portfolio and always-on common coverage as reference. Reenter or switch only on 12H boundaries; costs on real closes and new opens, 5bp and 5bp additional adverse slip.
scope: Ten named surviving major perpetuals; unlevered price returns, no historical funding or measured entry or exit depth. Explicit market-regime diagnosis; all dates have already been studied.
